name: Neelkanth Ltd.
summary: Neelkanth Ltd. primarily engages in the global distribution and commerce of agricultural commodities. The company's business is organized into two distinct divisions: Agro and Others. The Agro division mainly concentrates on the trading of rice. Concurrently, the Others segment encompasses a variety of service provisions and property rental operations. Established by Rashmikant Chunilal Bhimjyani on May 1, 1980, the firm's central office is located in Mumbai, India.
